backtest.commission_per_contract.meaning: Backtest only: the fee charged per contract in a simulation, as a fraction of the coin.
backtest.commission_per_contract.raise_risk: No effect on the live bot; a higher fee makes a backtest look worse.
backtest.commission_per_contract.raise_income: No effect on the live bot; a higher fee lowers the income a backtest shows.

backtest.fill_model.meaning: Backtest only: how a simulated order is priced. Today the simulator does not read it.
backtest.fill_model.raise_risk: No effect on the live bot or on today's simulator.
backtest.fill_model.raise_income: No effect on the live bot or on today's simulator.

backtest.limit_fill_rule.meaning: Backtest only: when a simulated limit order fills, on the next tick or at once.
backtest.limit_fill_rule.raise_risk: No effect on the live bot; filling at once makes a backtest look safer than a real market.
backtest.limit_fill_rule.raise_income: No effect on the live bot; filling at once can make a backtest look better than a real market.

backtest.margin_call_liquidation.meaning: Backtest only. Today the simulator does not read it.
backtest.margin_call_liquidation.raise_risk: No effect on the live bot or on today's simulator.
backtest.margin_call_liquidation.raise_income: No effect on the live bot or on today's simulator.

backtest.slippage_pct.meaning: Backtest only: how far from the mid price a simulated market order fills.
backtest.slippage_pct.raise_risk: No effect on the live bot; more slippage makes a backtest show larger losses.
backtest.slippage_pct.raise_income: No effect on the live bot; more slippage lowers the income a backtest shows.

delta_drift_threshold.meaning: A leg whose delta falls below this has little premium left, so it is bought back and sold again nearer the entry delta.
delta_drift_threshold.raise_risk: Raising it rolls legs sooner and more often, which adds fees and spread but keeps legs fresher.
delta_drift_threshold.raise_income: Raising it collects fresh premium more often, minus the fees and spread of each roll.
delta_drift_threshold.policy_note: This is a core-policy setting: a change needs the product owner.

delta_exit_threshold.meaning: A leg whose delta reaches this is bought back before the stop-loss, because the move is real.
delta_exit_threshold.raise_risk: Raising it waits longer before leaving a threatened leg, so a loss can grow closer to the stop-loss.
delta_exit_threshold.raise_income: Raising it keeps legs open through small moves, which can keep more premium.
delta_exit_threshold.policy_note: This is a core-policy setting: a change needs the product owner.

dte_delta_matrix[].deltas[].meaning: How far from the price each leg of a slot is sold, as delta.
dte_delta_matrix[].deltas[].raise_risk: Raising it sells closer to the price, so moves reach the strikes more often and stops come sooner.
dte_delta_matrix[].deltas[].raise_income: Raising it brings more premium per trade, with more stops and rolls to pay for.
dte_delta_matrix[].deltas[].policy_note: This is a core-policy setting: a change needs the product owner.

dte_delta_matrix[].dte.meaning: Each slot sells one strangle on an expiry about this many days away.
dte_delta_matrix[].dte.raise_risk: Raising it holds each trade longer, so it sits through larger moves.
dte_delta_matrix[].dte.raise_income: Raising it brings more premium per trade but slower time decay; lowering it means more rolls and fees.
dte_delta_matrix[].dte.policy_note: This is a core-policy setting: a change needs the product owner.

gamma_flip_buffer_sd.meaning: In a negative gamma regime a leg is shed only once the price is this far beyond the gamma flip.
gamma_flip_buffer_sd.raise_risk: Raising it sheds less often, so more exposure stays open in a falling market.
gamma_flip_buffer_sd.raise_income: Raising it keeps more legs selling, which keeps more premium but lowers protection.
gamma_flip_buffer_sd.policy_note: This is a core-policy setting: a change needs the product owner.

gex_direction.meaning: Which side to avoid in a negative gamma regime: the trend of moving averages (sma) or the price against the gamma flip (bias).
gex_direction.raise_risk: Neither choice is higher or lower; each changes which legs are shed and when they return.
gex_direction.raise_income: Neither choice is higher or lower; each changes how long legs wait before they are sold again.
gex_direction.policy_note: This is a core-policy setting: a change needs the product owner.

iv_margin_bands[].max_im_pct.meaning: The most initial margin the bot may use in that band.
iv_margin_bands[].max_im_pct.raise_risk: Raising it makes positions larger, so a move costs more.
iv_margin_bands[].max_im_pct.raise_income: Raising it sells more contracts, which brings more premium.
iv_margin_bands[].max_im_pct.policy_note: This is a core-policy setting: a change needs the product owner.

iv_margin_bands[].min_iv_pct.meaning: Where a margin band starts, as the percentile of today's dvol over the last year.
iv_margin_bands[].min_iv_pct.raise_risk: Raising it keeps the bot in a lower band for longer, which limits its size.
iv_margin_bands[].min_iv_pct.raise_income: Raising it keeps the bot smaller for longer, which brings less premium.
iv_margin_bands[].min_iv_pct.policy_note: This is a core-policy setting: a change needs the product owner.

max_leg_size_multiple.meaning: A new leg is at most this many times its slot's normal size.
max_leg_size_multiple.raise_risk: Raising it allows larger legs when the book offsets them, so a move can cost more.
max_leg_size_multiple.raise_income: Raising it allows more contracts per leg, which brings more premium.
max_leg_size_multiple.policy_note: This is a core-policy setting: a change needs the product owner.

max_mm_pct.meaning: Above this maintenance margin the bot cuts positions at market at once and opens nothing new.
max_mm_pct.raise_risk: Raising it leaves more room before forced cuts and less room before Deribit liquidates at 100.
max_mm_pct.raise_income: Raising it avoids cuts that sell positions in a hurry, but can lose more if the move continues.
max_mm_pct.policy_note: This is a core-policy setting: a change needs the product owner.

min_premium.meaning: The least premium a leg must bring at its lowest order price; a leg under it is not sold.
min_premium.raise_risk: Raising it skips thin strikes, which leaves fewer positions open.
min_premium.raise_income: Raising it skips cheap legs, so income is lower when premiums are low.
min_premium.policy_note: This is a core-policy setting: a change needs the product owner.

repair_cooldown_hours.meaning: After a stop-loss, delta exit or manual close, the leg is sold again no sooner than this.
repair_cooldown_hours.raise_risk: Raising it sells less into a move, but leaves the strangle one-sided for longer.
repair_cooldown_hours.raise_income: Raising it keeps a leg out for longer, which gives up its premium meanwhile.
repair_cooldown_hours.policy_note: This is a core-policy setting: a change needs the product owner.

roi_take_profit.meaning: A leg is bought back once it has earned this share of its premium, and sold again.
roi_take_profit.raise_risk: Raising it holds legs longer, so they stay exposed to moves meanwhile.
roi_take_profit.raise_income: Raising it waits for more of each premium, with fewer trades and fewer fees.
roi_take_profit.policy_note: This is a core-policy setting: a change needs the product owner.

rollout_dte.meaning: A strangle is bought back when its expiry is this close, and its slot opens a new one.
rollout_dte.raise_risk: Raising it leaves the riskier last days sooner, so a sudden move does less harm.
rollout_dte.raise_income: Raising it gives up the last days of time decay, which lowers income.
rollout_dte.policy_note: This is a core-policy setting: a change needs the product owner.

stop_loss_multiplier.meaning: A leg is bought back at market when its loss reaches this multiple of the premium it brought.
stop_loss_multiplier.raise_risk: Raising it allows a larger loss on one leg before it stops.
stop_loss_multiplier.raise_income: Raising it makes stops rarer, so fewer legs close on short spikes.
stop_loss_multiplier.policy_note: This is a core-policy setting: a change needs the product owner.

strategy_id.meaning: A name for the strategy in the journal and in order labels.
strategy_id.raise_risk: No effect: it changes no trading rule.
strategy_id.raise_income: No effect: it changes no trading rule.

underlying.meaning: The coin this bot trades, BTC or ETH; there is one config file per coin.
underlying.raise_risk: No effect on one bot: it names the bot rather than tunes it.
underlying.raise_income: No effect on one bot: it names the bot rather than tunes it.
